_comment: Corrections to STAGE (not deploy) on the staged-create service sourcing-staging, environment staging of project app.nordla.app. Non-secret values only. The registered commit is ab02b77; it must become the merged candidate. Config-as-code path and the auto-deploy rule were NOT in the lot. NOT applied.

source.branch_note: dedicated branch created at the pinned commit; nobody pushes to it, so a push by another chantier can never redeploy staging. It moves only by an explicit, authorised fast-forward. (claude/nordla-core-p0 receives pushes from several chantiers.)

settings_to_verify_or_add.config_as_code_why: without it the repository-root railway.json wins (start command without the Docker entrypoint, no Dockerfile builder: root user, volume not prepared)
settings_to_verify_or_add.auto_deploy: OFF if the Railway service offers the switch; otherwise rely on the dedicated branch release/sourcing-staging (no push = no redeploy). Either way: Deploy only on the owner's explicit go.

expected_lot_after_corrections.detail: 31 pending (28 service + 3 volume; the commit pin and the source branch are EDITS of existing lines) + 1 or 2 new settings (config-as-code path; auto-deploy switch if the UI has one). Any other new line must be a variable listed in this file.
